headline: Launcher fixes installation and Play, while Ratchet & Clank passes 86%
summary: OpenRAC released launcher 0.4.0 through 0.4.4, bundling setup tools and repairing Play, level extraction and Linux startup. Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 matched code rose from 81.10% to 86.02%. Going Commando gained 59 shared-function matches for USA v1.01, although its committed progress report was not refreshed. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game.
